text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: THRESHOLD ALERT for org=peregrinehealth — sustained QPS spike + elevated 5xx rate (5m avg)
Augie (oncall): I'm on it, paging SRE and Runtime. sharing logs and initial impact numbers.
Augie (oncall): Impact: 3% of requests seeing 504/timeout, p95 latency up 2.3x. Traffic is mostly from a single client token.
Emma-SRE: thanks. Is this an organic surge or a runaway job? any recent deploys?
Zara-Support: Customer reported degraded UX in the support ticket 5489, says "search returns timeouts intermittently".
Rafael-Runtime: No recent deploys. Checking request patterns — looks like many long-stream sessions + heavy embedding calls from that token.
Augie (oncall): Short mitigation plan: 1) immediate per-org emergency rate cap tweak (safe bump) 2) disable non-essential endpoints for that token (embeddings & long-poll) 3) enable traffic shaping + prefix-level batching tweaks 4) monitoring and rollback window.
Emma-SRE: Agreed. Rafael — can you apply an emergency soft-cap while we validate? We should avoid full cut-off.
Rafael-Runtime: Running admin command now:
```
# temporary org adjustment (15m)
redwood-admin org-adjust --org peregrinehealth --token-id tok_peregrine_01 --qps 400 --burst 800 --duration 15m --reason "emergency spike mitigation"
```
Rafael-Runtime: Command executed — response: OK (change_id=chg_20260317_01)
Augie (oncall): Noted. Emma — can you monitor error rate / latency delta and confirm customer requests are recovering?
Emma-SRE: Watching dashboards: error rate down from 3% -> 1.1% in the first 60s, p95 trending down. We'll keep 2-min cadence checks.
Zara-Support: Told customer we're applying a short mitigation and will follow up in 15m. They asked if we can raise quota instead of throttling — keeping them updated.
Emma-SRE: Rafael, also please gate embeddings for that token:
```
redwood-admin feature-toggle --org peregrinehealth --token tok_peregrine_01 --feature embeddings --state off --duration 20m
```
Rafael-Runtime: embeddings disabled for token. Confirmed.
ops-bot: :information_source: Audit log appended chg_20260317_01 by rafael-runtime (session 9934).
Augie (oncall): Can we also apply a lightweight traffic-shape rule to prioritize short completion requests?
Rafael-Runtime: Adding traffic-shape rule by prefix: requests with prompt_len < 512 prioritized, long sessions queued. Applying:
```
redwood-admin traffic-shape add --org peregrinehealth --rule "prompt_len<512 -> priority=high" --duration 20m
```
Rafael-Runtime: Rule applied.
Emma-SRE: Good signal: 2xx recovery for core endpoints, overall token QPS down ~45% (client already backing off some).
Augie (oncall): OK — we'll let this run 15m, then evaluate. If stable, revert embeddings toggle and gradually restore qps. If it worsens, we escalate to full token suspension.
Zara-Support: Customer acknowledges and appreciates quick action. Asking for postmortem once resolved.
Emma-SRE: Logging remediation steps for incident timeline. Links: dashboards.live/incident/2769998888 , logs.live/grep?org=peregrinehealth
Augie (oncall): Handoff to Emma-SRE for the next 30m watch. I'm going offline for urgent meeting but reachable. @Emma-SRE — take point for postmortem.
Emma-SRE: Taking point. Will collect timeline, root-cause candidates, and proposed guardrails (rate-change runbooks, token-level autoscaling thresholds).
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident wave mitigated to an acceptable state. Monitoring continues.
Augie (oncall): :thumbsup: thanks team.
Rafael-Runtime: I'll schedule a follow-up to roll the temporary changes back in a controlled canary after 15m if metrics stay green.
Emma-SRE: last check (now): p95 down, errors ~0.8%. continuing to watch.
ops-bot: :memo: Incident ticket created INC-20260317-2113 and linked to chg_20260317_01.
Zara-Support: Noted, will update customer after monitoring window.
Augie (oncall): Closing handoff. If anything flares, re-ping on this thread.
